summary: This plugin localizes the DeepSeek Harness web UI to Taiwan Traditional Chinese by adding a zh-Hant language option and applying Taiwan-oriented terminology replacements to interface text.

classificationSuggestion.reason: This plugin is primarily a user-interface localization plugin for DeepSeek Harness: it adds a Taiwan Traditional Chinese language option and rewrites interface copy to Taiwan terminology. Evidence shows it is installed as a DSH web plugin, injects into the web client, patches locale translation for zh-Hant, and applies additional label replacements in the DOM. It stores selected language in existing settings for persistence and states it only changes interface text, not user message content.
